newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOTOR RACING-BRIDGESTONE TO SUPPLY TYRES FOR FIVE TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-BRIDGESTONE TO SUPPLY TYRES FOR FIVE TEAMS.

text.p: Japan's top car tyre maker Bridgestone Corp said on Tuesday it would supply tyres to five Formula One teams for the 1997 season.

This is an increase of four teams since last October when Bridgestone said it would supply tyres for Arrows Grand Prix International in 1997, one year ahead of its goal as a result of faster tyre development.
The four other teams are Minardi, new Prost Grand Prix, new Stewart Grand Prix and Lola Formula One Ltd.

Bridgestone started developing tyres for Formula One racing in 1989 and has refined the tyres in collaboration with the British Automotive engineering company TWR (Tom Walkinshaw Racing) group which has owned Arrows since June last year.
Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co, which supplied all Formula One teams between 1992 and 1996, will supply tyres for the other seven racing teams in 1997.
The Formula One season opens with the Australian Grand Prix in Melbourne on March 9.
